## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2 / −1.2×10¹² (region-A cal, run 5)

Why: before committing hours to a fan, confirm SdH is resolvable at this rig's T_e on both carrier signs and see which tones exist. Run 6 rode 0 → 10 T at n = +3.2×10¹² (F_L = 33.1 T); run 7 rode 10 → 0.3 T at n = −1.2×10¹² (F_L = 12.4 T). Both complete, no leak trips, no rails (max 0.12 FS at 50 µV), T 1.17–1.29 K (drifts up with B).

**Read.** SdH is strong on both signs. **Electron side (run 6):** a light tone at **≈ 7.1 T** (F/F_L ≈ 0.21) persists down to the record edge (onset < 1 T, SNR 40) and stops above ≈ 7.5 T (R jumps 30 → 500 Ω at 7.7 T — its last LL leaving the Fermi level at B ≈ F), plus heavier content at 14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T (onsets 1.4–1.9 T). The onset tool labels 14/22/29.5 as harmonics of 7.1; with ΔF ≈ 1.6–2.4 T per tone that's not separable from independent heavy-band tones (a 7 + 22–26 T pair summing to F_L is what an ABAB split would give). **Hole side (run 7):** broad weight at **4.7–6.6 T** (dominant 6.6 T, onset 0.71 T) plus a strong **12.3 T ≈ F_L** tone at high B (total-density QH modulation — expected for any stacking). Qualitatively both spots sit on the two-band (ABAB-like) feasibility model from cell 39/41 (7.5/25.6 T; 5.3/7.1 T), **but not decisively**: (i) a ≈ 7 T tone at both +3.2 and −1.2×10¹² is also what a density-*independent* parasitic region would give (Si couples to the contacts); (ii) harmonics vs independent tones is ambiguous on single traces; (iii) region B (+0.43×10¹²) replicates every tone at shifted n. Also noted: run 6 Rxx dips to −33 Ω near 6 T → a small Rxy admixture in this pair; minima depths are not quantitative. **Next:** the D = 0 Landau fan — F(n) across the whole D = 0 window separates n-tracking bands from flat parasitic tones and mosaic replicas (plan step 4).

# Runs 6-7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (region-A cal, run 5). Raw first, then 1/B FFT + per-tone onsets.
import warnings
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
spots = {6: +3.2, 7: -1.2}                      # run id -> n (1e12 cm^-2), D = 0
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for k, (rid, n12) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col_at(r.col_indices("magnet_field")[-1])           # last magnet_field column
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain)
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 | F_L = {FL:.1f} T | {len(B)} pts, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T | "
          f"R(B<0.4) = {np.median(R[B < 0.4]):.0f} Ohm, R(B>9.6) = {np.median(R[B > 9.6]):.0f} Ohm | "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K | interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    ax[0, k].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, k].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    ax[1, k].plot(1 / B[B > 0.8], R[B > 0.8], lw=0.7); ax[1, k].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)")
    for lo, ls in ((1.0, "-"), (2.0, "--")):
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, 10), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        ax[2, k].plot(f, s[0] / s[0][f > 2].max(), ls, lw=1, label=f"FFT B {lo}-10 T (dF {1/(1/lo-0.1):.1f} T)")
    ax[2, k].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    ax[2, k].set(xlim=(0, 45), ylim=(0, 1.1), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="|FFT| (norm)"); ax[2, k].legend(fontsize=7)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
    print(on.summary()); [print("   warn:", str(x.message)[:160]) for x in w]
fig.suptitle("vti-02 runs 6-7: SdH spot checks at D = 0 (sr1 50 uV, 10 nA, T = 1.17-1.29 K)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`) — the stacking discriminator

> **05:28** · landau-fan D=0 (region-A cal run 5): n -1.24..+3.24e12 fast (113 pts, 0.04), Vtg/Vbg co-swept; B 10->0.8 T slow descending, 157 rows (0.2 T to 5.2 T, then d(1/B)=0.008); pre-ramp 0->10 T; fast 1 s, slow 3 s; sr1 200 uV; Vsi 0; base T · **ETA ~14:28** (≈9h)

**Why (plan step 4, `hera_scratch/plan.md`).** Runs 6/7 (ana, just landed) show strong SdH on both carrier signs: a light ≈ 7 T tone (onset < 1 T) plus heavier content, qualitatively matching the two-band ABAB feasibility numbers — but two single-density traces can't separate (a) n-tracking bands from a density-independent parasitic tone (Si-gated contacts), (b) independent heavy tones from harmonics, or (c) real second bands from region-B mosaic replicas (+0.43×10¹², run 5). A fan resolves all three from one measurement: ABAB → two branches F₁(n), F₂(n) that both scale with n and sum to F_L; ABCA → one F_L branch, no light tone; a parasitic tone → flat in n; a mosaic replica → same dF/dn as its parent, shifted −0.43×10¹² in n. The high-B rows add the QH sequence and LL-crossing pattern, and their minima (ν = nh/eB) check the absolute n scale (c_tg is still the 9.5 nm geometry prior).

**Design.** Fast: n = −1.24 … +3.24×10¹² at 0.04×10¹² (113 pts), (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept on the region-A D = 0 line (run-5 cal); the step resolves ≥ 3.5 pts per 4-fold LL period down to ~1.5 T. Slow: B **descending 10 → 0.8 T**, 157 rows — 0.2 T steps to 5.2 T (QH/crossings legible), then uniform in 1/B at Δ(1/B) = 0.008 (Nyquist 62 T vs F_max ≈ 38 T for region B at the top of the window; ΔF ≈ 0.87 T over 0.8–10 T, enough to split the hole-side ≈ 4.7/6.6 T pair). B_lo = 0.8 T sits just above the 0.71 T onset seen in run 7. Descending costs a 73 min unrecorded pre-ramp now, but the close-out ramp from 0.8 T is 6 min instead of 73, so session wall-clock is unchanged — and the decisive high-B rows land first, so the cheapest abort is on real signal. fast_delay 1 s (3.3 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB — same as run 5; a uniform ≈ 1-pt lag in n, same direction every row), slow_delay 3 s (10 τ after the flyback). sr1 fixed at **200 µV = 20 kΩ FS**: 34× the largest off-CNP R in runs 6/7 (0.59 kΩ at 10 T); the headroom is for the ν = 0 CNP at high B. Noise isn't sensitivity-limited (run 5 at 100 µV ≈ 2 Ω, run 6 at 50 µV ≈ 4 Ω). In-cell guards: gate leak > 1 nA, or T_sample > 2.5 K for 3 points → interrupt, gates to 0 V.

**Coverage trade.** Hole side stops at −1.24×10¹² (the D = 0 line hits the TG −0.3 V limit at −1.27; the limits are the operating box). D = 0 only — finite-D (the ±D R_CNP symmetry, ABCB test) is plan step 5, conditional on this read. B_lo 0.7 T instead of 0.8 would add ~20 rows (~50 min) for ~0.1 T better ΔF — not worth it.

**Price.** Pre-ramp 73 min + 157 rows × ≈ 139 s (113 × 1.14 s/pt, calibrated on run 5's 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1 s, plus the second gate set; + 3.5 s flyback + 3 s slow_delay + 3 s magnet settle) + 67 min of between-row ramps ≈ 8.4 h; headline ≈ 9 h. Ends at 0.8 T, gates at 0 V.

**Checkpoints.** (1) **After the pre-ramp:** T_sample back in 1.0–1.5 K (asserted in-cell). (2) **First rows at 10 T:** rails (sr1 > 0.9 FS outside |n| < 0.15×10¹² → abort, re-run at 500 µV — ~5 min lost, already at 10 T), gate currents, a ν = 0 peak at n ≈ 0 and structure along n. (3) **End of the 10 → 5.2 T block (~1 h 35 m into the fan):** re-form the partial map; QH minima vs ν = nh/eB → n-scale check; LL crossings. Abandon if featureless. (4) **At ~2 T (~3 h in) and ~1.2 T (~4.5 h in):** partial column FFT over the landed 1/B range — branch count and dF/dn; continue unless the answer is already unambiguous and the rest adds nothing.

# === D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`): B slow 10 -> 0.8 T (descending), n fast -1.24 .. +3.24e12 on the region-A D = 0 line ===
# Plan step 4. Pre-ramp 0 -> 10 T (gates at 0 V, unrecorded), then multimegasweep: slow = magnet.field,
# fast = (k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt) co-swept along D = 0. Ends at 0.8 T; gates parked at 0 V.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, c_tg = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.linspace(-1.24, 3.24, 113), 4)                 # 1e12 cm^-2, 0.04 step; n = 0 at index 31
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.round(Vtg_vec, 5), np.round(Vbg_vec, 5)
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(_n_chk - n_vec).max() < 1e-3 and np.abs(_D_chk).max() < 1e-3

# --- field grid: 0.2 T steps 10 -> 5.2 T (QH region, crossings legible), then uniform in 1/B, d(1/B) = 0.008, 5.0 -> 0.8 T ---
B_hi = np.round(np.arange(10.0, 5.1999, -0.2), 4)
B_lo = np.round(1.0 / np.linspace(0.2, 1.25, 132), 5)
B_vec = np.concatenate([B_hi, B_lo])
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) < 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"n: {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12, {len(n_vec)} pts | Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} .. {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} .. {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V | B: {len(B_vec)} rows {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T")

# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
_chk = {
    "T_sample (K)":      (_T0, "1.0-1.5", 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5),
    "B (T)":             (_B0, "|B| < 0.02 (handoff parked 0 T)", abs(_B0) < 0.02),
    "V_si (V)":          (k_si(), "0", abs(k_si()) < 0.01),
    "V_tg, V_bg (V)":    ((k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt()), "0, 0", abs(k_tg.volt()) < 1e-3 and abs(k_bg.volt()) < 1e-3),
    "nplci tg/bg":       ((k_tg.nplci(), k_bg.nplci()), "1, 1", k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1),
    "PS heater, output": ((magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()), "True, True",
                          magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()),
    "sr1 drive":         ((sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()), "1.0 V, 13.777 Hz",
                          abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency() - 13.777) < 0.01),
    "tau sr0/sr1 (s)":   ((sr0.time_constant(), sr1.time_constant()), "0.3, 0.3",
                          sr0.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.time_constant() == 0.3),
}
for _k, (_v, _exp, _ok) in _chk.items():
    print(f"[{'OK  ' if _ok else 'FAIL'}] {_k}: {_v} (expect {_exp})")
assert all(_ok for _, _, _ok in _chk.values()), "precondition mismatch — not starting"

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Largest off-CNP R seen (runs 6/7 at 10 T) 0.59 kOhm;
# headroom is for the CNP (nu = 0) at high B. Noise is not sensitivity-limited (run 5 @100 uV ~2 Ohm, run 6 @50 uV ~4 Ohm).
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (20 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

# --- pre-ramp 0 -> 10 T, gates at 0 V (blocking, ~73 min at 0.137 T/min; unrecorded) ---
print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} pre-ramp {_B0:+.4f} -> {B_vec[0]} T ...")
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
_T1 = T_sample()
print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} at B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T; T_sample = {_T1:.3f} K")
assert 1.0 <= _T1 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T1} K off base after the pre-ramp — not starting the fan"

# --- station ---
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T1
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D=0: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts) fast, co-swept (Vtg, Vbg) on region-A D=0; "
                  f"B {B_vec[0]}->{B_vec[-1]} T slow ({len(B_vec)} rows: 0.2 T to 5.2 T, then d(1/B)=0.008); Vsi 0; sr1 200 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 (region A, run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} prior, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, '
              f'D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}); fast n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 step 0.04 ({len(n_vec)}); '
              f'slow B {B_vec[0]}->{B_vec[-1]} T descending ({len(B_vec)} rows; 0.2 T steps to 5.2 T, uniform 1/B below, d(1/B) 0.008); '
              f'fast_delay 1 s, slow_delay 3 s; sr1 200 uV; Vsi 0')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg (fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.5          # A (either gate), K (3 consecutive points)
_hot = [0]
def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, t = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    _hot[0] = _hot[0] + 1 if t > T_TRIP else 0
    if _hot[0] >= 3:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T: T_sample = {t:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K for 3 points")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=3.0, fast_delay=1.0, init_delay=True)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T (field left here), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
